name: Rasoi
registryBasis: Identity unresolved. The official Sonipat district village list places Rasoi among villages in Rai block, and India’s official 2011 Census dataset classifies Rasoi(42) as a village (census location code 06 076 00380 059883 0000). The queue point and name are consistent with that village, but those sources do not reconcile the queued WUP cityCode and 703,790-person city population with the small village identity. Thus no city-code-bound registry finding is asserted.

technicalBlocker: The Sonipat district website says Haryana registration/mutation/Jamabandi records can be viewed by owner name, khewat, or khasra; those are property/person lookup keys, so no record search was made. The queue’s population/city classification conflict remains unresolved, and no village geometry schema was verified.
